q: What is the carbon footprint of a slaughterhouse per tonne of meat?
title: Slaughterhouse: emissions per tonne
short: The plant's own share is electricity for chilling and freezing, boiler fuel for hot water, refrigerant leaks and methane from effluent ponds. The animals raised for it carry a far larger upstream footprint, which belongs in Scope 3. Divide plant emissions by tonnes of dressed meat.

ul: Scope 1: boiler fuel, refrigerant leaks, effluent methane from open ponds.

p: Open anaerobic lagoons release methane. Covered digesters that capture and burn the gas cut it sharply.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
